query: I swear the drive over here was total chaos today—there was a fluffy golden retriever trotting right down the middle of the main road by the park, holding a whole slice of pepperoni pizza in its mouth like it had just pulled off the heist of the century, and every single car stopped to watch it instead of honking. I even rolled my window down to cheer it on before a very flustered teen came sprinting after it, yelling that their dog had stolen their lunch off the picnic table and bolted before they could grab him. It was so funny I sat through two whole green lights just cackling, and the person behind me didn’t even honk because they were laughing too hard at the dog trotting away like he owned the place. Hey, can you help me find a good microplush throw from this section? I’m looking for one that feels really nice to the touch, y’know? I also need the 40"x30" extra small size made for pets, please. I don’t wanna spend more than that usual amount I stick to for these kinds of purchases, so make sure whatever you pull up fits that limit too.
